inputs.question: What is polymorphism in Java?
inputs.initial_response: Polymorphism means many forms. It allows objects to be treated as instances of their parent class.
inputs.followup_question: Can you explain method overriding vs overloading?
inputs.followup_response: Overloading is compile-time polymorphism where methods have same name but different parameters. Overriding is runtime where a child class provides a specific implementation of a parent's method.
